In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
SentiCircles is a lexicon based sentiment analysis approach which is able to capture and update the contextual semantics of words to improve the sentiment analysis performance.
our approach is better at identifying neutral tweets and better at identifying positive tweets, while the state of theart approach is better at detecting negative tweets.
our approach outperforms SentiStrength in accuracy and F measures in most of the experiments and is comparable to SentiStrength in other cases.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our approach outperforms SentiStrength in accuracy in 2 out of 3 datasets for tweet level sentiment detection and performs better in accuracy in all 3 datasets for subjectivity detection.
SentiCircles is an efficient and effective approach for sentiment analysis of tweets.
our proposed SentiCircles approach can capture the contextual semantics of words to update their sentiment polarities in lexicons, and can be used to detect sentiment at both entity and tweet level.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the contextual semantics of a word can be used to improve sentiment analysis of Twitter.
the semantic of words is highly contextual, and thus, the sentiment of words should be determined based on their context in tweets.
the semantic of words in tweets can be effectively captured and updated by their co occurrence patterns in the context of tweets, leading to better sentiment analysis results.
